title: Twitch is using your content to train Amazon's AI. Here's how to opt out.
content_html:
Creating content on Twitch? Unless you've changed your settings, it's being used to train AI.

Twitch creators recently spotted a "Training for Generative AI" setting in account security that's toggled on by default. "Allow your channel content to train generative AI content models at Amazon," the description reads. Needless to say, people weren't happy.

Digging in to Amazon-owned Twitch's FAQs reveals a bit more information on what, exactly, this means.

You May Also Like

"Generative AI content models are AI tools that can help create or synthesize content outputs like text or images when given instructions or prompts because they are also trained on content," reads the FAQ. "When you allow training, that means that your content may be used for future Gen AI model improvements. An example of what happens when you allow your content to be used for training a GenAI content model is that your audio might help refine models that create speech to text, which would help improve captions at Twitch but would also help improve captions across Amazon."

Addressing the backlash during a livestream on Wednesday, Twitch's chief product officer Mike Minton gave a slightly revealing answer to the question of why the option was switched on by defaul.

Mashable Light Speed

“Well, there’s an honest answer,” Minton said, per Kotaku. “And I think most of you probably can appreciate this: If it was opt-in, nobody would opt-in. Um, that’s honestly the answer. So it’s going to be on by default.”

Mashable has reached out to Twitch for comment.

How to opt out of training AI on Twitch

The option to opt out of having your Twitch content used by Amazon to train generative AI is somewhat buried in the Settings.

Click on your profile picture, then head to Settings, and then Security and Privacy. Here, you can find the Training for Generative AI toggle and switch it off.

Twitch FAQs note that toggling off won't affect AI-supported features on your channel, such as captions and safety tools.

content_html_zh:
在 Twitch 上创建内容？ 除非你改变了你的设置，否则它会被用来训练人工智能。

Twitch 创作者最近在账户安全中发现了默认开启的“生成人工智能训练”设置。 描述中写道：“允许您的频道内容在亚马逊训练生成人工智能内容模型。” 不用说，人们并不高兴。

深入研究亚马逊旗下 Twitch 的常见问题解答，可以了解更多关于这到底意味着什么的信息。

你可能也喜欢

常见问题解答中写道：“生成式人工智能内容模型是人工智能工具，可以在给出指令或提示时帮助创建或合成文本或图像等内容输出，因为它们也经过了内容训练。” “当你允许训练时，这意味着你的内容可能会用于未来的 Gen AI 模型改进。 当您允许您的内容用于训练 GenAI 内容模型时，您的音频可能有助于完善将语音创建为文本的模型，这将有助于改善 Twitch 的字幕，也有助于改善整个 Amazon 的字幕。”

在周三的直播中，Twitch 的首席产品官 Mike Minton 在回应这一强烈反对意见时，对为什么默认开启该选项的问题给出了一个略带启发性的答案。

可混搭光速

据 Kotaku 报道，明顿说：“好吧，这是一个诚实的答案。” “我想你们大多数人可能都会理解这一点：如果是选择加入，那么没有人会选择加入。 嗯，这就是诚实的答案。 所以它会默认开启。”

Mashable 已联系 Twitch 征求意见。

如何选择退出 Twitch 上的 AI 训练

选择不让亚马逊使用您的 Twitch 内容来训练生成人工智能的选项在某种程度上隐藏在“设置”中。

单击您的个人资料图片，然后前往“设置”，然后前往“安全和隐私”。 在这里，您可以找到“生成人工智能训练”开关并将其关闭。

Twitch 常见问题解答指出，关闭不会影响频道上支持 AI 的功能，例如字幕和安全工具。
